sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN c.YearlyIncome < 30000 THEN '1. <30K'
    WHEN c.YearlyIncome < 60000 THEN '2. 30K-60K'
    WHEN c.YearlyIncome < 90000 THEN '3. 60K-90K'
    WHEN c.YearlyIncome < 120000 THEN '4. 90K-120K'
    ELSE '5. 120K+'
  END AS IncomeBracket,
  countDistinct(c.CustomerKey) AS Customers,
  sum(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSpend,
  sum(f.SalesAmount) / nullif(countDistinct(c.CustomerKey), 0) AS AvgSpendPerCustomer,
  corr(c.YearlyIncome, f.SalesAmount) AS IncomeSpendCorrelation
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
WHERE c.YearlyIncome IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY IncomeBracket
ORDER BY IncomeBracket
